title: It's Showtime at the Apollo
description:
S1 E122 — Episode 122
It's Showtime at the Apollo is a syndicated music television show, first broadcast on September 12, 1987. The show features live performances from both professional and up-and-coming artists, and also features the Amateur Night competition.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E20 — The Amazing Kreskin, Diana Sands, Dom DeLuise
Kreskin performs magic and acts in a sketch w/Flip & Diana Sands; Dom DeLuise battles Geraldine in the grocery store.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E21 — Della Reese, George Carlin, Roy Clark
Carlin & Flip report the news; Carlin does a monologue on race & society and the cast does a comic courtroom scene.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E22 — Rich Little, Ed McMahon, Cicely Tyson
Cast does a Tonight Show spoof with Rich as Johnny Carson; Flip & Cicely’s honeymoon gets disrupted by dentists.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E23 — Tim Conway, Joe Namath
Legendary New York Jets quarterback Joe Namath holds his own with sketch comedy pros Tim & Flip incl. a Geraldine bit.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E16 — Andy Griffith, Roscoe Lee Browne
Andy Griffith and Tony Award winner Roscoe Lee Browne join Flip for a game show parody called Buzz Off and a lighthouse sketch.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E24 — Richard Pryor, Don Knotts
Fresh from acting in Lady Sings The Blues, Richard Pryor does brilliant stand-up and skits with veteran funnyman Don Knotts.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E19 — Strike A Pose
Moesha enters a modeling contest sponsored by a magazine being held at the Den.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E3 — Casino Evil
